title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Senior backend engineer and distributed systems architect responsible for high-throughput scalability, sharding and replication topologies, CQRS/Event Sourcing data pipelines, distributed transaction consistency (Sagas), mTLS zero-trust communication, continuous profiling, and disaster recovery.

skills.rationale: Architecting load shedding, graceful degradation, calculating RPO/RTO for multi-region disaster recovery, and managing distributed locks.
Architecting CQRS read/write models, Event Sourcing append-only event stores, and Service Mesh mTLS routing.
Designing sharded and horizontally partitioned tables, replication failover architectures, and distributed transaction Sagas.
Architecting idempotent consumers, multi-node Redis Clusters with Sentinel, and stream backpressure flow control.
Instrumenting SLI/SLO error budget telemetry, conducting continuous production profiling with Pyroscope Flamegraphs, and correlating traces with logs.
Architecting mTLS zero-trust service identity, engineering application-layer DDoS/brute-force defense, and building tamper-evident audit logs.
Designing distributed rate limiting algorithms, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) gateways, and reliable webhook dispatching systems with HMAC signatures.
Enforcing mutation testing quality metrics, architecting deterministic test data factories, and running chaos engineering fault injections.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in distributed systems design, data consistency, or high-scale resilience.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Solid mid-level backend implementation, but lacks experience in distributed transaction Sagas, sharding, and multi-region disaster recovery.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong technical capabilities across most areas; refining expertise in CQRS, stream backpressure, and chaos testing.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all senior expectations: designs high-throughput distributed systems, guarantees data consistency, mentors teams, and enforces resilience standards.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds senior expectations: staff/principal level impact across core backend platforms and enterprise distributed systems architecture.
